title: Marvel Age #23 1985 Rom Wraith War Bill Sienkiewicz Cover Marvel News Magazine
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear; light toning on the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Marvel Age #23 (February 1985), Marvel Comics - the official Marvel news magazine. "Beyond the Wraith War... Future ROMifications" - Bill Sienkiewicz Rom cover. 35 cent cover price.

Back cover: Starstruck #1 (Epic Comics) ad by Elaine Lee and Michael Wm. Kaluta.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; light toning on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
